Image URL: https://i2.ruliweb.com/img/4/E/6/2/4E628336344ABF1258# Fantasy Masters Korean Card Game Battle Screen

A detailed battle interface from the Korean online card game Fantasy Masters features a dark, gothic board with creature cards positioned in play. The top of the screen shows SP gains (“SP 60을(를) 획득하였습니다.” and “SP 80을(를) 획득하였습니다.”), while the center displays cards such as Prism Dragon, 활각메뚜기, and Green Scouter with their costs, attack/defense stats, and special modifiers. On the right, player names HolyHall and 구로레더 appear with life points and SP totals, alongside controls for flipping cards, shuffling the deck, and ending the turn.

The bottom panel reveals the player’s hand of terrain cards and interface buttons labeled Ready, Shuffle, and Quit. Turn 10 is in progress, and the overall aesthetic combines dark fantasy art with a user interface showing detailed card information and game status.

판타지 마스터즈와 이 게임 진짜 개오랜만이다 (https://bbs.ruliweb.com/community/board/300143/read/61451980)
【turn382010image1】<<ImageDisplayed>>
Image URL: https://i1.ruliweb.com/img/23/05/13/188128e934318abc4.jpg# Fantasy Masters Duel Interface

A Korean fantasy card game duel screen presents two players, Judys and EM_Invader, engaged in battle. The top of the interface reminds players that victory comes when an opponent’s life or deck is fully depleted. EM_Invader taunts the opponent in Korean, challenging them to reveal their true skill.

In the center, two character cards—케이시 (Inner Will) and 스컬파이터 (Long-Range Attack)—display their stats and abilities, each accompanied by a 50% coin indicator. The UI features auto-stop controls and a dark, ornate background depicting a mysterious female figure holding a glowing orb. This screenshot evokes nostalgia for the classic 'Fantasy Masters' game discussed in a Korean forum post about its sudden server shutdown and comparisons to Hearthstone.

Image URL: https://i3.ruliweb.com/img/23/05/13/188128e914118abc4.jpg# Fantasy Masters Penguin Battle Screen

The image captures a battle interface from the Korean online card game Fantasy Masters, featuring a set of penguin-themed cards in play. The central focus is on the "펭귄돌격병" (Penguin Charger) card, displaying its stats (+3 공격, 0 방어, 0 체력) and a Korean flavor text describing a charge through enemy lines. Surrounding cards include "펭귄나이트" (Penguin Knight), "펭귄연락병" (Penguin Messenger), and utility cards like "포류" and "로터스," each marked with LP=1.

System messages at the top left confirm that chat content and screen captures have been saved. The right panel shows game details: Turn 15, 1540 SP, and life points for multiple players. A chat log beneath lists Korean text about saved captures. The overall UI uses a dark fantasy theme with blue card borders and stylized artwork, indicating an active multiplayer match in progress.
